articles.title: Tokenization's next use case is personalized portfolios, NYLIM executive says
articles.snippet: Thomas Sy, head of multi-asset solutions at the $800-million asset manager, says blockchain can enable complex portfolio construction that's not yet possible in traditional finance.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s next parabolic run may need $1 trillion in fresh capital
articles.snippet: This cycle, about $697 billion in new money has generated a roughly 689% gain, compared with earlier cycles where far less capital drove returns of upto 50,000%.
